verdict.rationale: Shopify's theme store offers professionally designed prebuilt themes that it calls 'fully flexible and regularly updated' and invites merchants to 'customize from there.' The homepage also pitches picking a prebuilt theme or designing fast with AI, which covers the core of launching a polished storefront from themes. The evidence is short marketing copy, though, and never explicitly describes a no-code section or layout editor or branding controls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of no-code customization of sections, layout and branding (e.g., a visual theme editor), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the merchant theme-customization experience.
